4261.title: Native browser target failures have no recovery state
4261.rootCauseOneLine: Pending, failed, absent, and mismatched desktop target checks share a text-only fallback with no recovery controls.
4261.proposedFix: Separate target verification states and define explicit URL reopening versus native session recovery.
4261.caveats: Component behavior repeated in two clean checkouts; native restart/reload and Connect lifecycle not tested live. Reproduction test is inline in the report.
